punchline: According to Warren Berger, questioning often has an inverse relationship to expertise: the people who know a field best ask its most basic question least.
thirty_sec: When the Airbnb founders pitched their idea, angel investor Paul Graham said no one would want to stay in someone else's bed. He later invested. Warren Berger uses the scene to show that questioning often goes down as expertise goes up. Even attorneys are trained never to ask a question they don't know the answer to. His fix is the beginner's mind: look at your own field as if for the first time.
